title: Custom Sort String
description:
The characters in `order` are distinct and define a preferred order. Rearrange the characters of `s` so that characters appearing in `order` follow that order. Characters absent from `order` come afterward in ascending character order. Return the resulting string.

## Examples

```text
Input: order = "cba", s = "abcd"
Output: "cbad"
```

```text
Input: order = "bcafg", s = "abcd"
Output: "bcad"
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= order.length <= 26`
- `1 <= s.length <= 200`
- Both strings contain lowercase English letters.
- Characters in `order` are distinct.
